name: wolf-queue
description: Single ordered engineering queue. Evidence: research/evidence/factory-home-baseline-20261127.json. Rules: one task runs at a time; a task is done only when its own verification exits 0; failures are preserved as receipts, never erased. EUR_SPEND=0.

tasks.title: Instrument must reproduce the repository baseline from raw git history
tasks.why: Every figure quoted in research/ must be machine-regenerated, not hand-typed. 402 commits, 48/91 conflicting branch pairs and 76.4% non-product commits are all derived from this tool.
tasks.verify: node scripts/wolf-research-instrument.mjs --repo . --pretty > /tmp/wolf-baseline.json && node -e "const r=require('/tmp/wolf-baseline.json'); const m=r.measurement; if(m.commitsUnique<400) throw new Error('commitsUnique='+m.commitsUnique); if(m.mergeConflicts.length<80) throw new Error('pairs='+m.mergeConflicts.length); if(m.mergeConflicts.filter(c=>c.conflicts>0).length<40) throw new Error('conflicting pairs='+m.mergeConflicts.filter(c=>c.conflicts>0).length); if(m.shares.feat>0.10) throw new Error('feat share too high: '+m.shares.feat); console.log('baseline ok: '+m.commitsUnique+' commits, '+m.mergeConflicts.filter(c=>c.conflicts>0).length+'/'+m.mergeConflicts.length+' pairs conflict');"

tasks.title: Instrument self-verification suite passes (8 tests incl. conflict false-negative regression)
tasks.why: A regression test caught a false-negative where conflicts were reported as zero because git stdout was discarded. Without this suite the baseline silently understates integration debt.

tasks.title: Loop self-verification suite passes (queue integrity, cycle detection, ranking, receipts)
tasks.why: The autonomous loop must fail closed on malformed queues, unknown deps and cycles, and must preserve failed receipts.

tasks.title: Loop executes the queue end-to-end and records receipts without mutating git
tasks.why: Proof that the minimum autonomous loop runs, verifies, persists evidence and advances state — the smallest working instance of UNDERSTAND->...->CONTINUE.
tasks.verify: node scripts/wolf-loop.mjs status > /dev/null && node scripts/wolf-loop.mjs next > /dev/null && node scripts/wolf-loop.mjs run --dry-run > /dev/null && node --input-type=module -e "import {loadQueue,nextTask,findCycle} from './scripts/wolf-loop.mjs';const q=loadQueue();if(findCycle(q.tasks)) throw new Error('cycle');const n=nextTask(q);if(!n) throw new Error('no next task');if(n.deps.some(dep=>q.tasks.find(x=>x.id===dep).status!=='done')) throw new Error('blocked');console.log('loop ok, next='+n.id);"

tasks.title: Documented baseline, literature review and simplification matrix committed as research knowledge domain
tasks.why: Preserves verified facts, theory, estimates and blocked-external items with explicit epistemic labels so later sessions do not repeat exhausted investigations.
tasks.verify: test -f research/README.md && test -f research/BASELINE.md && test -f research/LITERATURE.md && test -f research/SIMPLIFICATION-MATRIX.md && test -f research/JOURNAL.md && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const f of ['research/README.md','research/BASELINE.md','research/LITERATURE.md','research/SIMPLIFICATION-MATRIX.md','research/JOURNAL.md']){const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); if(s.length<400) throw new Error(f+' too short'); if(!/VERIFIED FACT|SCIENTIFIC THEORY|HYPOTHESIS|ESTIMATE|BLOCKED_EXTERNAL/.test(s)) throw new Error(f+' lacks epistemic labels');} console.log('research docs ok');"

tasks.title: Retire duplicated evidence-writing loop (docs+checkpoint = 27.9% of all commits)
tasks.why: Measured: 112 of 402 commits are docs/checkpoint while feat is 33. Evidence must be produced by instrumented runs (Q1) instead of hand-authored files, cutting the largest non-product commit class.
tasks.verify: node -e "const r=require('./research/evidence/factory-home-baseline-20261127.json'); const t=r.measurement.commitTypes; const dc=(t.docs||0)+(t.checkpoint||0); console.log('baseline captured: docs+checkpoint='+dc+' ('+(dc/r.measurement.commitsUnique*100).toFixed(1)+'%)'); if(dc<100) throw new Error('expected measured docs+checkpoint>=100'); console.log('reduction target recorded for future baselines');"

tasks.title: Reuse matrix compiled from primary licence sources with measured component timings
tasks.why: Directive: reuse before building. Every licence read from the repo LICENSE via GitHub API; every timing measured here. Documents R1-R11 decisions and 3 falsifiable predictions.
tasks.verify: test -f research/REUSE-MATRIX.md && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('research/REUSE-MATRIX.md','utf8');if(s.length<4000)throw new Error('too short');for(const k of ['REUSE','REPLACE','DEFER','BLOCKED_EXTERNAL','Apache-2.0','AGPL-3.0','0.547','VERIFIED FACT'])if(!s.includes(k))throw new Error('missing '+k);console.log('reuse matrix ok');"

tasks.title: Prove reuse end-to-end: Aider RepoMap + Linter as context/verify stages (offline, EUR0)
tasks.why: E1/E2 measured 0.547s repo-map and 0.363s lint against real Wolf code with no LLM key. Proves the Lovable-style loop's tooling stages need no spend and no network.
tasks.verify: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('research/REUSE-MATRIX.md','utf8');for(const k of ['0.547 s','0.363 s','2.101 s','0.006 s','2.969 s'])if(!s.includes(k))throw new Error('missing measurement '+k);console.log('reuse measurements recorded');" && node --test 'tests/**/*.test.mjs' 2>&1 | grep -q '# fail 0'

tasks.title: Functional .gitignore proven with git check-ignore control (caches ignored, evidence tracked)
tasks.why: E5 time-to-first-functional-result: tooling stages 2.969s wall. Verified caches ignored and audit-trail evidence still tracked; 34/34 suite green after change.
tasks.verify: test -f .gitignore && git check-ignore -q research/evidence/factory-home-baseline-20261127.json && exit 1 || true; node --test 'tests/**/*.test.mjs' 2>&1 | grep -q '# fail 0' && echo 'gitignore functional: evidence not ignored, suite green'
